title: Finished Carousel Object
description: What the pipeline returns after rendering. Carries render identity, image location, timing, errors, and the fields reserved for future approval. Defined in DC-003-T002 §4 and §7. Extended in DC-003-I034 to carry TWO possible content-lineage paths, never both, never neither (see `$defs.legacyLineage`/`$defs.productionPackageLineage` below): the original Topic Package -> Carousel Content Object lineage (`topic_id` + `carousel_content_id`, DC-003-I001-I012's own pipeline), or the newer Production Package lineage (`production_package_id`, DC-003-I030-I034's own pipeline, which has no topic_id/carousel_content_id concept at all — see production-package.schema.json). Every Finished Carousel produced before DC-003-I034 already satisfies the legacy lineage shape unchanged; nothing about an existing stored record needs to change.

topic_id.description: Required-present (see this schema's own top-level `required`), but nullable as of DC-003-I034 — null on a Finished Carousel built from the newer Production Package lineage, which has no Topic Package/topic_id concept at all. See `$defs.legacyLineage`/`$defs.productionPackageLineage` for the rule governing which combination of topic_id/carousel_content_id/production_package_id is actually legal.

carousel_content_id.description: Required-present, but nullable as of DC-003-I034 — same rationale as topic_id above.

production_package_id.description: DC-003-I034 — the newer Production Package lineage identifier (see production-package.schema.json). Deliberately NOT in this schema's own top-level `required` list (unlike topic_id/carousel_content_id) so every Finished Carousel produced before this milestone, which never mentions this field at all, remains valid unchanged — its absence is equivalent to null. Non-null only on a Finished Carousel built from a Production Package; see `$defs.productionPackageLineage`.

execution_metadata.description: This carousel's execution trace identity, introduced in DC-003-I007. execution_id is the trace identifier future milestones (DC-003-I008 Execution Logging) are expected to carry forward — its pattern matches execution-log.schema.json's own execution_id exactly for that reason.

approval.description: Reserved for future use — see DC-003-T002 §7. No approval workflow is implemented; this block is always null or all-default in the MVP.

legacyLineage.description: DC-003-I001-I012's original lineage: both topic_id and carousel_content_id are real, non-null identifiers. production_package_id, if present at all, must be null — a Finished Carousel can never claim both lineages at once. Every Finished Carousel produced before DC-003-I034 already matches this shape (production_package_id simply never appears in it, which is equivalent to null here).

productionPackageLineage.description: DC-003-I034's newer lineage: production_package_id is a real, non-null identifier, and topic_id/carousel_content_id (still required-present by this schema's own top-level `required`) must both be explicitly null — never a fabricated Topic Package/Carousel Content Object identifier, since neither exists anywhere in the I030-I034 pipeline.
